snippet.title: The Legend of Baboo - Gameplay Trailer v2
snippet.description:
New gameplay from the great adventure of The Legend of Baboo, coming to Steam and Xbox. Wishlist now on Steam - https://bit.ly/3Ua4m9G.

Two heroes, one legend. Play as both Sepehr and his loyal dog, Baboo, in this mystical, third-person, action-adventure. Together the duo sets off on a journey through magical lands to rescue their family from a dark and ancient evil.

STUDIO:  Permanent Way
DISCORD: https://bit.ly/3HwLoDF
